title: LandlordGuard Late Fee Tenure Credit Table
content:
**Q. Does a long-standing landlord pay less when a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy installment is late?**
A. Yes. The late-fee tenure credit looks at whole months from the original effective date to the charge date: 120 months or more take 4.00 USD off; 60 to 119 months take 2.00 USD off; fewer than 60 months take nothing off. The credit is taken off in the late-fee adjustment.

**Q. Which date starts the count?**
A. The original effective date, the policy's first inception date, not the start of the current term. The count ends on the date the late fee is charged, and only completed months count.

**Q. Where are the edges?**
A. With a hypothetical charge date of 15 September 2025:

| Original effective date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 15 September 2015 | 120 | 4.00 USD off |
| 16 September 2015 | 119 | 2.00 USD off |
| 15 September 2020 | 60 | 2.00 USD off |
| 16 September 2020 | 59 | nothing |

**Q. Is the credit the same for a policy renewed many times?**
A. Renewals do not restart the count; a policy first written 130 whole months before the charge date takes 4.00 USD off whatever the number of terms since.
